title: Mega Man ZX ADVENT
collection: Mega Man Zero/ZX Legacy Collection · DS
intro: A transformation route with four health upgrades, four tanks, four Biometal energy upgrades and the equipment quests kept beside their destinations.
libraryIntro: Transformation abilities, all health/tank/energy upgrades and optional boss medals.
primer: Choose Grey or Ashe at the start. Their opening stages and some transformation attacks differ. Grey’s Model A charge is a conventional blast; Ashe’s pierces targets. Both follow the same main destinations after the Train.

A-Trans copies defeated bosses. Some forms are made for a particular obstacle rather than ordinary fighting: Rospark climbs bars, Chronoforce slows time, Queenbee flies, and Argoyle’s summoned partner reaches items through walls. Transform freely when the next obstacle calls for it.

Transformation energy is shared and refills over time. Four BM Upgrades extend that meter. Four Life Ups extend health; four Sub Tanks store extra health for later. This game does not use ZX’s damaged-Biometal recovery levels.

Use Transervers to save and travel. Activate field transport points with crystals when needed. Item B chips must be enabled in the menu. Normal mode is the reference here; Expert removes many hidden upgrades, and Beginner simplifies hazards.
features: The four humanoid models provide familiar combat and movement; the eight Pseudoroids solve more specialized obstacles. ZX is gained at the Quarry.
Health, tanks and energy upgrades help the first clear. Disks, room furnishings, calendar gifts and the 24 boss medals are optional. Medals do not unlock your ordinary transformations.
routeIntro: Tower before Arctic gives Rospark for the first tank. The story then opens the other destinations. Follow their order below; return for late-form pickups before entering the final route.
route: Clear Grey’s or Ashe’s introduction and the Train. Repair the Train when the story asks you to.
After Tower and Arctic, continue past the last Transerver toward the Oil Field. Open its barrier with Fire on the blue orb, Thunder on red and Ice on green.
After Bio Lab, collect the remaining upgrades and quests. Enter Undersea Volcano through Bio Lab 3, then follow the story into Ouroboros.

stages.name: Buckfire
stages.tip: Use charged Model A shots between his attacks. Buckfire crosses wide gaps and supplies fire attacks.

stages.name: Rospark
stages.tip: Use Buckfire fire attacks when he is exposed. Rospark grips vertical bars that other forms cannot climb.

items.name: Life Up · Tower 3
items.text: After Spidrill, climb the outside of the tall crumbling pipe on its right side. Reach the top rather than entering the pipe.
items.extra: Return with Featherweight, Aeolus or Queenbee if the pipe climb is uncomfortable.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

stages.name: Chronoforce
stages.tip: Attack the exposed underside; the shell blocks attacks. Time Bomb slows moving hazards and timed gates.

items.name: Sub Tank · Arctic 2
items.text: Near the upper-right of the area, use Rospark to climb the vertical bars to the high ledge.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

stages.name: Atlas
stages.tip: Keep clear of her fists and use thunder when safely in range. Atlas breaks marked blocks and can aim the trajectory of her shots.
stages.now: BM Upgrade · Oil Field 2 · Featherweight Chip

items.name: BM Upgrade · Oil Field 2
items.text: Return after Atlas. Go right from Antonio’s room, then break the floor tiles in the pipe route and follow the lower sand passage right.
items.extra: Increases the shared transformation energy meter.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

items.name: Featherweight Chip
items.text: Break the floor near the start of Oil Field 2 with Atlas and find Antonio’s room on the lower route. Accept his wrench request, climb to the top of that room, then return the wrench.
items.extra: Keeps fragile platforms intact and prevents sinking into soft terrain.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

stages.name: Siarnaq
stages.tip: Keep moving between his kunai volleys. Siarnaq hangs from overhead bars and his lower-screen radar identifies real doors.

items.name: Sub Tank · Legion 2
items.text: Find the jet sled near the bottom, right of the glass-enclosed E38 disk. As Siarnaq, press Jump twice to hang from it. Shoot through the glass as it carries you toward the tank.
items.extra: Switch to a wall-jumping form if you need to recover over a pit.

media.alt: Siarnaq hanging beneath a jet sled in Legion HQ
media.credit: The MegaMaster / MMHP · Advent jet-sled screenshot

items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

stages.name: Thetis
stages.tip: Atlas fire exploits his weakness. Thetis swims and shows underwater hazards on the lower screen.

items.name: BM Upgrade · Highway 1
items.text: Under the highway, break Atlas blocks beside the red timed gate. Use Chronoforce Time Bomb, hit the red switch, then loop up, right and down through the opened gate.
items.extra: Aeolus makes the timed return easier.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

stages.name: Aeolus
stages.tip: Use ice during his pauses and stay clear of the tornadoes. Aeolus provides air dashes and hovering.

items.name: Sub Tank · Meg’s artifacts
items.text: Talk to Meg in the Floating Ruins 3 cave. Deliver each artifact separately: L Tank above the Ruins 1 entrance; Pinwheel near the Ruins 2 tornadoes; Old Balancer through the upper-left Ruins 3 door; Light Bulb beneath the central end platform in Ruins 4. Talk again after the fourth delivery.
items.extra: Carry one artifact at a time. A new one replaces an undelivered artifact, and death can remove it.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

stages.name: Queenbee
stages.weakness: Ice · Thetis; Aeolus for reaching it
stages.tip: Use Aeolus to extinguish fires along the route. Attack the vulnerable body or hive when an opening appears. Queenbee flies and lifts water containers.
stages.now: Life Up · Control Center 1 · Wind Boots Chip

items.name: Life Up · Control Center 1
items.text: At the elevator, climb the bars above the shaft with Rospark instead of riding inside. The upgrade is at the upper left.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

items.name: Wind Boots Chip
items.text: Accept Tillis’s fire request in Train 3 after obtaining Queenbee. In Legion HQ 2, lift the water container to the right of the burning building and pour it over the fires. Report to Tillis.
items.extra: Stops ground wind from pushing you.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

stages.name: Vulturon
stages.tip: Attack between his musical waves. His hovering helps cross the spike passages; use Siarnaq radar to avoid false doors.

items.name: Life Up · Scrapyard 2
items.text: Take the blue-marked door to the right of the red-marked door. Navigate the spike corridors with Vulturon’s hover to reach the upgrade.
items.extra: Use the ordinary corridor route; this guide does not rely on a timed-wall bypass.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

stages.name: Model ZX
stages.reward: ZX A-Trans · Aile for Grey, Vent for Ashe
stages.tip: Avoid the triple slash and punish the landing. Keep enough distance to read the next attack, then dash through the open space.

items.name: BM Upgrade · Quarry 3
items.text: Go through the door after the tank chase and immediately return, removing the timer. Break the side blocks with Atlas to reach the upgrade above the pit; leave its supporting block intact.
items.extra: If it falls, leave and re-enter to reset it.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

stages.name: Argoyle and Ugoyle
stages.tip: Keep both opponents in view. Model A homing shots can target both. Their transformation can summon a partner that moves through walls to retrieve items.

items.name: Life Up · Waterfall 2
items.text: At the open waterfall area, swim upward on the left waterfall with Thetis. Enter the hidden ledge doorway and cross the short spike passage.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

items.name: Extender Chip
items.text: Find Peter behind the upper waterfall doorway near the Ruins 3/4 boundary. Clear the Chabanos in his back room, then accept his 50-Chabano request. Search Oil Field 2, Legion HQ 1, Highway 1, Floating Ruins 3 and Scrapyard 2; report when all 50 are gone.
items.extra: Extends the protected period after a hit.
items.when: Return after unlocking the listed form

stages.name: Hedgeshock
stages.tip: Use fire and leave room to dodge her rolling attacks. Hedgeshock fits narrow passages.

items.name: Sub Tank · Mysterious Lab 3
items.text: Finish the battery-placement puzzle, climb the ladder and enter the upper room. The tank is behind a pipe. Charge Argoyle’s secondary attack to summon Ugoyle through the obstruction and retrieve it.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

stages.name: Bifrost
stages.tip: Use fire on the exposed parts and avoid his closing jaws. Bifrost breaks the large blocks needed for late returns.

items.name: BM Upgrade · Bio Lab 2
items.text: Lift the first hatch with Queenbee to drain the upper water. Stand on it as another form to close it again. Go right and lift the second hatch; water fills the lower area, raising the platforms beside the upgrade.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

stages.name: Hunter’s Camp equipment
stages.tip: Once rooms and quests open, collect these chips before the Undersea Volcano. Talk to the residents marked with an exclamation point.
stages.now: Absorber Chip · Eraser Chip · Ice Boots Chip · Frog Chip

items.name: Absorber Chip
items.text: Use the Green Card Key to enter the green-door room in Camp 3. Speak to John and buy the chip for 99 EC.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

items.name: Eraser Chip
items.text: Ask Warren and Blossom in Camp 3 for the flower quest. Collect the lily just outside the Waterfall Ruins 2 exit and deliver it.
items.extra: Lets Saber attacks erase small energy shots.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

items.name: Ice Boots Chip
items.text: Finish the camp expansion and shelves requests. Speak to Sharon by the Camp 3 green door, buy a comic at the Train 3 shop with the money she gives you, then deliver it.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

items.name: Frog Chip
items.text: After furnishing the expanded Camp 4 building, speak to Carley in a lower room. Take her transmitter to the Mechaniloid remains at the bottom-right of Oil Field 1, beneath the ladder. Return to Carley.
items.when: First visit, or return if missed

returnIntro: Open each destination to see all deferred items together. Collect the Floating Ruins quest pieces one at a time and deliver them to Meg before picking up the next.
completionText: Normal: four Life Ups, four Sub Tanks, four BM Upgrades, all 13 ordinary A-Trans forms and seven ordinary equipment chips. Calendar gifts and Model a are optional.

sections.title: Undersea Volcano and Ouroboros
paragraphs: Prometheus and Pandora share health. Use ZX charged attacks or aerial Saber slashes while reading the fire and ice patterns. Keep clear of Pandora’s surrounding staff pieces.

In Ouroboros, clear enemies without destroying the blocks you need to stand on. Chronoforce gives more time on disappearing blocks; Siarnaq lets you target enemies precisely. Stand on the rematch crystals and press Up.

Hydra: attack the body at the neck bases, not the heads. Atlas provides steady damage. Against Albert, break the rotating pieces protecting him, then strike during the exposed interval. ZX charged shots and Saber are reliable choices.
The final fights form one sequence. Refill tanks before starting and keep a spare save before the final route. Save the offered clear data after the ending.

sections.title: Optional · 24 boss medals
sections.html:
After late-story progress, speak to the Hunters on the camp rooftops for rematches. Attempt one medal at a time. “Only” restricts damage throughout the fight; “finish” specifies the last hit. Collect all 24 on Normal, then start another save to unlock the small Model a after receiving Model A. It is a bonus challenge form, not a stronger armor.

BossBronzeSilverGold
BuckfireFinal hit: Hedgeshock rolling attackDamage only the weak pointOnly Siarnaq lower-screen targeted kunai
RosparkFinal hit while in bulb formOnly Argoyle/Ugoyle attacksOnly Rospark attacks
ChronoforceFinal hit: ZX charged SaberFinal hit: Buckfire Slash DashOnly Queenbee attacks
QueenbeeDamage only the hivePrevent all summoned beesDamage only the body; never hit hive
VulturonFight for more than 120 secondsFinal hit: Aeolus Sonic BoomOnly Model A Giga Crush
Argoyle/UgoyleFinish both together with Giga CrushFinish both together with Hedgeshock Spark BallFinish both together with Buckfire Double Tomahawk
HedgeshockFinal hit: ChronoforceFinal hit by knocking her summoned rat backOnly untransformed attacks
BifrostOnly Queenbee attacksOnly Buckfire attacksOnly Model A Homing Shot

For Siarnaq’s targeted kunai, use the collection’s lower-screen cursor controls. Change the DS screen arrangement if the target is hard to select. Giga Crush depends on the weapon meter; plan Vulturon’s gold attempt before increasing that meter if you want a simpler attempt.

sections.title: Useful tips
paragraphs: After repairing the Train, speak to the second shop attendant in Train 3 to fill each Sub Tank for 50 EC. This paid service is available outside Expert mode; on Expert, refill through ordinary energy drops.
Expand Camp 4’s leftmost building through its donations and drill request to unlock the furnishing quests and Nick’s E-Tank shop. E-Tanks are consumables, separate from reusable Sub Tanks.
Siarnaq’s radar distinguishes real Scrapyard doors. Thetis reveals underwater hazards before you drop. Featherweight helps in the Scrapyard and Bio Lab as well as the Tower climb.

sections.title: Optional · calendar equipment
sections.html:
In the Oil Field 3 airship, donate a total of 600 EC to Tom to open both buried rooms. The second room can give month-dependent equipment. These bonuses are not needed for the main route; ordinary chips have no calendar restriction.

MonthItemEffect
FebruaryDemon BusterImproves Buster damage
MarchBaby DollImproves female Pseudoroid attacks
MayWarrior HelmetImproves male Pseudoroid attacks
JuneSoccer BallChanges Argoyle’s thrown bombs
OctoberMagic PumpkinExtends elemental effects
